explanation: Maria is a postulant at Nonnberg Abbey in Salzburg. The real von Trapps left Austria by train in 1938, rather than hiking over the Alps as the film shows.

claims.text: In The Sound of Music (1965), Maria is a postulant at a convent, Nonnberg Abbey, before she becomes governess to the von Trapp children.
Maria is not living in an orphanage, a boarding school or a mountain hut when she is sent to the von Trapps.
The real von Trapp family left Austria by train in 1938.
In the film, the family escapes on foot over the mountains.
